lensXraySay: Ruwan tabarau na X-ray. Nuna kowane abu don ganin yadda aka yi shi.
lensMakersSay: Ruwan tabarau na masu yi. Nuna kowane abu don ganin wanda ya yi shi.
lensFlagSay: Ruwan tabarau na tuta. Zaɓi ɓangaren da kake son bayar da rahoto ko kake fata.
lensesOffSay: An kashe ruwan tabarau. Tsarin yana aiki kamar yadda aka saba; gefuna suna nuna tabarau har yanzu suna kunne.
followingSay: Ana bin {name}: duk abin da suka yi an zayyana shi. Danna kowane ɓangare don ganin wasu da suka yi shi.
putOnSay: Kana ganin abin da Future Traveler ke gani. Nuna kowane abu don ganin yadda aka yi shi.
holdingSay: An tsaya a kan {tag}. Danna Escape don sakewa.
ownerOutside: Ba daga HAX ba; ba a san wanda ya yi shi a nan ba
nothingOnScreen: Babu abin da suka yi a wannan allo yanzu. Buɗe edita ko wani shafi kuma ɓangarorinsu za su haska.
shotFailedSay: Ba a iya yin hoton allo a nan ba, don haka batun yana ɗauke da hoton X-ray maimakon haka.
shotReadySay: Hoton allo a shirye yake. Zai tafi allon kwafi idan ka buɗe batun, don ka iya liƙa shi.
shotBlockedSay: Burauzarka ta toshe kwafin hoton. Danna dama a kan hoton allo ka zaɓi Copy image, sannan ka liƙa shi a cikin batun.
shotCopiedSay: An kwafi hoton allo. A cikin batun, danna inda aka ce a liƙa, sannan ka danna Ctrl+V (Cmd+V a Mac).
copyBlockedSay: Burauza ta toshe kwafi. Zaɓi rubutun maimakon haka.
flaggedSay: An yi wa {tag} tuta. Bayyana abin da ka gani ko abin da kake fata ya yi.
notRegistered: Wannan ɓangare ba ya cikin rajistar HAX, don haka ba a san tarihinsa a nan ba.
agentCommits: Ƙarin {commits} da aka yi da wakilan rubuta lamba, mutanen da ke sama suka jagoranta.
shotFailedCaption: Hoton X-ray, {w} x {h} px. Ba a iya yin hoton allo a nan ba.
shotAltWhole: Hoton allo tare da {tag} an zayyana
shotCaption: {w} x {h} px PNG, {kb} KB. Idan an toshe kwafi, danna dama a kan hoton ka zaɓi Copy image.
copyShotOpenIssue: Kwafi hoton allo ka buɗe batu
